---
name: Document Correction
about: Report a typo, citation problem, inconsistency, or factual correction in a public CBA document
title: "[CORRECTION] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## File and section
Identify the exact file, heading, article, section, or paragraph.

## Current text or problem
Describe the issue briefly. Quote only the minimum text necessary.

## Proposed correction
Provide replacement language if possible.

## Source or evidence
Provide a public source, archival citation, or explanation supporting the correction where relevant.

## Material or non-material?
Does this change meaning/policy, or is it only spelling, formatting, citation, or clarity?

## Privacy notice
Do not upload private genealogy evidence, birth certificates, government IDs, addresses, signatures, raw DNA data, account information, or other sensitive records.
